import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class rib {
        long b, u, c, f;
        int back;
    }

    static void add_rib(List<List<rib>> g, long a, long b, long u, long c) {
        rib r1 = new rib();
        r1.b = b;
        r1.u = u;
        r1.c = c;
        r1.f = 0;
        r1.back = g.get((int) b).size();
        rib r2 = new rib();
        r2.b = a;
        r2.u = 0;
        r2.c = -c;
        r2.f = 0;
        r2.back = g.get((int) a).size();
        g.get((int) a).add(r1);
        g.get((int) b).add(r2);
    }

    static class Pair implements Comparable<Pair> {
        long fi, se;

        public Pair(long fi, long se) {
            this.fi = fi;
            this.se = se;
        }

        @Override
        public int compareTo(Pair o) {
            return Long.compare(fi, o.fi);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        long n = 50 * 99 + 1, m, k = (long) 1e18, c, d;
        List<List<rib>> g = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            g.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        k = Long.parseLong(br.readLine().split(" ")[3]);
        d = Long.parseLong(br.readLine().split(" ")[4]);
        long tim = 99;
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            long lr = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
            add_rib(g, 0, lr, 1, 0);
        }
        for (int j = 0; j < tim - 1; j++) {
            for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
                add_rib(g, j * 50 + i, (j + 1) * 50 + i, 50, c);
            }
        }
        for (int j = 1; j < tim; j++) {
            add_rib(g, j * 50 + 1, 1, 50, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            String[] s = br.readLine().split(" ");
            long x = Long.parseLong(s[0]);
            long y = Long.parseLong(s[1]);
            List<Long> vr = new ArrayList<>();
            vr.add(y);
            vr.add(x);
            for (int j = 0; j < tim - 1; j++) {
                for (int l = 0; l < 50; l++) {
                    add_rib(g, j * 50 + x, (j + 1) * 50 + y, 1, (c + d * ((l + 1) * (l + 1) - (l * l))));
                    add_rib(g, j * 50 + y, (j + 1) * 50 + x, 1, (c + d * ((l + 1) * (l + 1) - (l * l))));
                }
            }
        }
        long s = 0, t = 1;
        long flow = 0, cost = 0;
        while (flow < k) {
            List<Long> id = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                id.add(0L);
            }
            List<Long> d = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                d.add((long) 1e18);
            }
            List<Long> q = new ArrayList<>();
            List<Long> p = new ArrayList<>();
            List<Integer> p_rib = new ArrayList<>();
            int qh = 0, qt = 0;
            q.add(s);
            d.set((int) s, 0L);
            while (qh != qt) {
                long v = q.get(qh++);
                id.set((int) v, 2L);
                if (qh == n) {
                    qh = 0;
                }
                for (int i = 0; i < g.get((int) v).size(); i++) {
                    rib r = g.get((int) v).get(i);
                    if (r.f < r.u && d.get((int) v) + r.c < d.get((int) r.b)) {
                        d.set((int) r.b, d.get((int) v) + r.c);
                        if (id.get((int) r.b) == 0) {
                            q.add(r.b);
                            if (qt == n) {
                                qt = 0;
                            }
                        } else if (id.get((int) r.b) == 2) {
                            if (--qh == -1) {
                                qh = n - 1;
                            }
                            q.set(qh, r.b);
                        }
                        id.set((int) r.b, 1L);
                        p.add(v);
                        p_rib.add(i);
                    }
                }
            }
            if (d.get((int) t) == (long) 1e18) {
                break;
            }
            long addflow = k - flow;
            for (int v = (int) t; v != (int) s; v = (int) p.get(v)) {
                long pv = p.get(v);
                int pr = p_rib.get(v);
                addflow = Math.min(addflow, g.get((int) pv).get(pr).u - g.get((int) pv).get(pr).f);
            }
            for (int v = (int) t; v != (int) s; v = (int) p.get(v)) {
                long pv = p.get(v);
                int pr = p_rib.get(v);
                int r = g.get((int) pv).get(pr).back;
                g.get((int) pv).get(pr).f += addflow;
                g.get((int) v).get(r).f -= addflow;
                cost += g.get((int) pv).get(pr).c * addflow;
            }
            flow += addflow;
        }
        pw.println(cost);
        pw.close();
    }
}
